name: Big Coulee Dam Campground
note: City of Bisbee campground on the east shore of the Big Coulee Dam (Bisbee Dam) reservoir, about 1 mile east of town on Dam Rd; camping is on mown lawn between shelterbelt rows near a shelter, playground, swim beach and fishing pier, with no pads seen on imagery. No fees, hookups, season or booking method are published and no phone was found; confirm with Bisbee city hall (302 Main St) before going. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds list (updated 07.17.2025, read 2026-11-12) row 27: BIG COULEE DAM CAMPGROUND, 302 MAIN ST, BISBEE, Towner, owner CITY OF BISBEE, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 7/20/2023, 100 lots -> a state-licensed municipal campground with designated lots, not a lawn allowance; separate from row 32 BISBEE RV PARK (same city-hall address, 5 lots) = existing 6010 in town 1.9 km SW. ND State Auditor 2023 City of Bisbee report shows a Campground Fund (enterprise) with $11,363 rental fees. Options Outdoors (Towner County as managing agency) and a 2019 Google review of 'Bisbee Dam-Big Coulee Boating Access' (4.7/9) name a campground, swim beach, boat landing and fishing pier. Esri imagery 2026-11-12: gravel Dam Rd to a lawn on the east shore with ~4 shelterbelt rows, ~8 trailers/motorhomes parked on grass between them incl. a ~12 m bus, a shelter, playground and fire ring -> 23-ft fit shown; no pads (padless lawn = keep with caveat). No horse facilities, no 4WD/road warning. No agency web page, fees or phone found (no city website exists; ndtourism refuses). Public (local): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (500 m frame at 48.6375,-99.3610; z18 at 48.6385,-99.3622; z19 at 48.6380,-99.3622 and 48.6365,-99.3620): the camping lawn sits on the reservoir's east shore but a continuous band of shrubs, trees and reeds ~20-35 m wide runs the whole shoreline between the lawn and open water; the only open shore is a small sand beach with docks/pier at ~48.6370,-99.3633, used for swimming, with no units beside it. The northernmost clearing (a trailer and a bus, ~48.6386,-99.3621) is ~25-35 m from water behind a thinner shrub fringe; no site map or designated pad exists, so no site is proven on or overlooking the water -> default down to not waterfront. Below-the-dam check: the earthen dam (OSM 'Big Coulee Dam' 48.63361,-99.36320; NID 48.63335,-99.3651) closes the reservoir's south end ~500 m south; the campground is on the upstream (reservoir) side, Open-Meteo DEM 481-484 m on the lawn vs 478 m on open water, so above pool, not below the dam.
flags: 6010 is a different place (not a duplicate): HHS licenses two City of Bisbee parks sharing the city-hall address 302 Main St - BISBEE RV PARK (5 lots) and BIG COULEE DAM CAMPGROUND (100 lots). 6010's pin 48.62622,-99.37627 is right: imagery shows an in-town grass lot by the rail line and elevator with 3-4 RVs.

6010 corrections (from RV Life park 256953, read 2026-11-12): published name there 'Bisbee City Campground', address 455 Schoener St (302 Main St is City Hall/mailing, per state auditor + federal vendor registry; HHS name 'Bisbee RV Park'), 6 sites (HHS: 5 lots), pull-through, phone 701-656-3569 (Bisbee 656 exchange; holder unconfirmed - likely city hall), $15/night; the only review (motorhome, stayed 7/2020, $15): 'Very small full hookup grass CG. Usually not crowded, but if it were you couldn't put slides out' - a free truck scale to the east, grocery 18 mi away in Cando. So 6010 can take hookups electric+water+sewer (dated 2020 camper report), fees $15 camper-reported 7/2020 (older than the 2024 bar for a rate), and phone 701-656-3569 if AWH accepts RV Life's number.

Operator conflict: HHS licence and the National Inventory of Dams (via damsoftheworld) give the City of Bisbee; Options Outdoors names Towner County as managing agency. The 1967 SWC report lists the City as sponsor with the Towner County Park Board. Stored as local either way.

Possibly mostly seasonal: 100 licensed lots but only ~8 units on imagery, some parked under trees in a way that may be long-term; no count of nightly vs seasonal lots exists anywhere (test 4 passes on no count). A phone call to Bisbee city hall would settle fees, hookups, season and the seasonal share - candidate for audit/verify/phone_list.md.
Waterfront may be lakeview at the north clearing (~25-35 m from water behind a thin shrub fringe) if sites are ever confirmed there.
Name on aggregators: 'Bisbee (Big Coulee) Dam' (The Dyrt, Campendium, AllStays: tent/no details). No Google Maps campground listing at the dam; Google has only the boat-ramp place.
